verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs, such as periodic audits or timed publishing, is a plausible capability for a documentation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no scheduler. Docs Audit is described as a one-off "single pass" run, and the GitHub AI Writer is triggered by pull requests rather than run on a recurring schedule. Neither counts as scheduled recurring workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
